title: Axis-anchored geometry-semantic event-relation Teacher feasibility
purpose: Prove that the frozen C01-C08 dataset contains sufficient independent structure-event identities, route views, temporal branch relations and geometry targets to train the proposed GSE-Graph representation before any new model is implemented or trained.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 read-only Teacher feasibility audit over C01-C08; no training, new inference, checkpoint selection, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph replay or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User instructed continuous autonomous execution, approved all in-scope operations, and delegated best-method choices without routine approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed deduplicated five-frame causal range-image dataset exported from procedural C01-C08 worlds.
Sealed TNG node, directed-exit and association identities used only as Teacher labels.
Sealed spline and geometry targets for local axis, width, height, slope and curvature.
Sealed descriptor-transport and stateful-commit feasibility summaries used only as prior evidence.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.audit_scope: Exactly 60 fit and 20 selection worlds from C01-C08. Strict test and downstream benchmark worlds are forbidden.

sampling.rule: Audit every frozen C01-C08 observation once. Association identities define independent event episodes; adjacent rows are related only within the same directed traversal.

teacher.source: TNG supplies objective event, directed-exit and association identities; splines supply route axis, slope and curvature; mesh/geometry parameters supply width and height.
teacher.valid_mask: Missing width/height and exit-width values remain masked; no target is imputed.
teacher.runtime_exclusion: Association identity and directed-exit identity may supervise MIL/contrastive relations but are forbidden from model forward inputs and deployment.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph or planner is run. A later graph may commit a node from a stable learned event, while an edge requires physical traversal.

split.independent_unit: association identity and procedural world, not adjacent frame
split.selection: C01-C06 define fit supervision and C07-C08 define development selection only.
split.strict_test_policy: C09/C10 and M-TARE are unread and cannot influence representation, normalization, thresholds or checkpoint selection.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Old model summaries supply only fixed baseline evidence. No old checkpoint, prediction, threshold or identity is loaded into a new model because this audit performs no model execution.

methods.main: Axis-Anchored Geometry-Semantic Event Relation: anchor branches by sensor-forward route motion, supervise event type plus persistent/reveal/withdraw branch relations, regress branch/global geometry and uncertainty, and retain a past-only episode branch-union memory.
methods.baseline: Old one-shot complete-set regressors and the high-precision hand-written stateful commit policy are retained only as paper baselines/ablations.
methods.fallback: If identities lack exact stars, junction route diversity, temporal relation samples, geometry coverage or causal route anchoring, stop this candidate before training and reconsider the representation.

failure_policy: Do not train, infer, access strict test worlds, relax thresholds, invent identities, impute targets, or compensate in graph/planner. Any source, count, split, Teacher or integrity drift seals FAIL.
retention: Retain compact summary, identity/event CSVs, paper-ready PNG/PDF/SVG and figure source, logs, environment, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU-only deterministic audit of 188126 frozen observations and 4493 event identities
